observations: Sodium C14-16 Olefin Sulfonate is the primary cleanser after water; sulfate-free marketing does not make the cleanser weak.
Cocamidopropyl Betaine and Cocamide DIPA support the cleanser/foam system.
Shea butter, glycol distearate, panthenol, cationic guar and Polyquaternium-39 create moderate conditioning/deposition plausibility.
Disodium EDTA and the usage text about a second wash for heavy buildup support a residue-removal/reset-adjacent role.
Parfum and fragrance allergens are present; no silicones are visible.

claims.textVerbatim: Sulfate-free curl cleansing cream, removes buildup, shea butter, no silicones/mineral oils.
